detail.longDescription:
wBlock is a free, open-source ad blocker for Safari. It blocks ads and trackers all over the web with more than 750,000 filter rules, and it never asks you to subscribe.

Blocks ads in Safari
wBlock leans on Safari's own content blocking, so pages come up clean and fast. Lists like AdGuard Base and EasyList refresh in the background, and you pick which ones run.

Handles the sites filters can't
Built-in userscripts get past anti-adblock walls and pop-ups. You can drop in your own userscripts and userstyles as well, and Return YouTube Dislike is one tap away.

Zap anything you don't want to see
The element zapper lets you tap a cookie banner or overlay and hide it, and wBlock remembers it next time you visit.

Light on memory
wBlock sits at about 40 MB of RAM when idle, so Safari stays quick.

Your call on every site
Turn blocking off for a site with one tap, or pause wBlock for a while when you need to. Settings sync over iCloud and can be saved to a file.

Private by design
wBlock collects no data and needs no account. The code lives on GitHub, so anyone can look at what it does.

Free for good
No subscriptions and no in-app purchases.
